plan.question: Does the retained finite-model NIII+CIII discrimination survive uncertainty in their relative multiplicative response?
plan.gain_convention: Truth has unit NIII/CIII response. Alternative NIII gain relative to CIII is in [1-h,1+h]; null independently profiles both nonnegative ion amplitudes. These are counterexamples/stress bounds, not measured calibration errors or priors.
plan.stopping_rule: Execute this fixed nuisance test only; no thermal grid or response-family expansion. Stop on input identity/contract failure or compute cap.
plan.expected_output: Hardest enhanced-versus-ordinary model separation and matched total SNR by relative-gain freedom, with paired-environment controls and an independent ion-amplitude limit.

truth_convention: enhanced model at unit relative response; matched total bundle SNR
measurement_scope: retained equilibrated model predictions; no new pixels or observed likelihood
interpretation: Finite-family nuisance stress bounds, not posterior odds, abundance or a demonstrated calibration requirement.
